morbi.headline: Mixed margin pressures for Morbi ceramics as energy costs fluctuate amid weak exports.
what_changed: Industrial propane gas prices increased by ₹3 to ₹104/kg while natural gas prices received a ₹5 discount.
Ceramic exports to the Gulf resumed, though the general export outlook remains depressed.
Local manufacturers raised unresolved power, water, and infrastructure issues with state ministers.
stress_signals: Industrial propane gas hiked by ₹3 to ₹104/kg, inflating production costs [9e8c549b7c05]
Persistent infrastructural issues including power supply and water availability [8b17a473b62a]
Overall export demand for Morbi ceramic shipments remains weak despite Gulf trade resuming [c2b4a2f5422a]
Suspicious imported coal stock found in a closed ceramic factory in Rafaleshwar GIDC [f675c060fa53]
improvement_signals: Natural gas prices reduced by ₹5 from ₹82 following ministerial intervention [279312659941]
Kajaria Ceramics reported Q2 2026 sales and profit beats and invested ₹1.21 Cr in Sunsure Solar [83abd2d67eca, a2787358932e]
Ceramic export shipments to Gulf destinations have resumed [c2b4a2f5422a]
what_to_watch: Margin impact on unorganized tile units balancing higher propane costs against natural gas discounts.
Order book strength and receivables tracking for units dependent on Gulf export corridors.
Operational continuity and power stability metrics following ministerial representations.

surat.headline: Surat cluster faces severe textile trade payment blockages alongside diamond export demand mixed signals.
what_changed: Textile weavers and traders are experiencing escalating liquidity stress, with payment dues exceeding 200 days ahead of Diwali.
Labor dispute in the embroidery sub-segment resolved via an agreement, while textile manufacturing faces risks of fresh unrest.
Government updated the Textile PLI scheme, cutting the turnover limit by 50% and extending it through FY 2033-34.
Diamond sub-segment shows conflicting signals of pre-Diwali demand resurgence against global US demand slumps and regional rough shortages.
stress_signals: Severe textile trade payment crisis with receivables stretch crossing 200 days, causing protests and police involvement [e0787797133b, 774ba602b06e, 9a8429b49c99, 80f44f3f370f]
US demand slump impacting apparel and diamond exporters, drying up orders and shutting units [561255a9240b]
Surat textile mills impacted by unquantified power cuts and electricity tariff hikes [385f9b90ae46]
Rough diamond shortages in nearby Bhavnagar forcing office closures, signaling broader supply chain risks [f374a30b31ac]
improvement_signals: Textile traders in Global, Bombay, and Ring Road markets successfully recovered ₹6 crore in stuck payments for 70 units [a523a4bf860d]
Embroidery labor movement ended following owner-labor agreements [3a495ae0b3ee]
Textile PLI scheme turnover threshold reduced by half and extended to FY 2033-34 [c7ee55f3effe]
what_to_watch: Resolution efficiency of trade receivables across weaving and trading accounts post-festive dispatches.
Potential fresh labor unrest or agitations disrupting MMF weaving and processing production cycles [d1fffb80f879].
Account-level utility bill surges and margin compression in textile mills due to power tariff hikes [385f9b90ae46].
Diamond processing unit working capital utilization rates amid US order slowdowns and rough supply shortages [561255a9240b, f374a30b31ac].
